# Turn a 60-page lease into a one-page abstract and a deadline calendar.

> Free commercial lease abstract tool: paste a lease and get the key terms, a calendar of renewal-notice and rent-step dates (downloadable .ics), the year-by-year rent schedule and the clauses to negotiate, such as personal guaranty, NNN pass-throughs, holdover rent and relocation. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/commercial-lease-abstract-reader/)
